summary: TechPrecision Corp filed an 8-K reporting a Fourteenth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Loan Agreement with Beacon Bank Trust. The amendment extends the maturity of a $4.5M revolving credit facility from May 15, 2026 to September 15, 2026, adds covenants requiring refinancing term sheet by July 31, 2026, and includes a $15,000 failure-to-perform fee. No stake, price, or premium. This is a routine credit extension, not a special situation. Watch for refinancing risk or default if terms unmet.
